chat_messages: Can you set up a pipeline to first trim Illumina reads and then assemble them for Listeria?
consultant_reply:
I will design a two-step pipeline. First, I'll use **fastp** (step_1PP_trimming__fastp) for fast, all-in-one read trimming and quality control. The cleaned reads will then be passed to **SPAdes** (step_2AS_denovo__spades) for high-quality *de novo* assembly of your *Listeria* isolate.

Let me know if you approve this plan.
diagram_code:

```mermaid
    subgraph entrypoint

        step_1PP_trimming__fastp(fastp Trimming)
        step_2AS_denovo__spades(SPAdes Assembly)
        input -->|raw_reads| step_1PP_trimming__fastp
        step_1PP_trimming__fastp -->|out.reads| step_2AS_denovo__spades
    end
```
